item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/Dec/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of southern China tomorrow. The weather will be rather cool in the morning over the region, and cold over the inland areas. A broad band of clouds will also cover the region. Under the persistent influence of the dry monsoon, the band of clouds will thin out. It will be mainly fine over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. Daytime temperatures will rise, but it will still be cool in the morning and at night. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
